subcommands.name: start-loader-job
subcommands.description: Starts a Neptune bulk loader job to load data from an Amazon S3 bucket into a Neptune DB instance. See Using the Amazon Neptune Bulk Loader to Ingest Data.

options.name: --source
options.description: The source parameter accepts an S3 URI that identifies a single file, multiple files, a folder, or multiple folders.

options.name: --format
options.description: The format of the data. For more information about data formats for the Neptune Loader command, see Load Data Formats.

options.name: --s3-bucket-region
options.description: The Amazon region of the S3 bucket. This must match the Amazon Region of the DB cluster

options.name: --iam-role-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for an IAM role to be assumed by the Neptune DB instance for access to the S3 bucket.

options.name: --mode
options.description: The load job mode.  Allowed values: RESUME, NEW, AUTO.  Default value: AUTO.

options.name: --fail-on-error
options.description: FailOnError    –   A flag to toggle a complete stop on an error.  Allowed values: "TRUE", "FALSE".  Default value: "TRUE".

options.name: --no-fail-on-error
options.description: FailOnError    –   A flag to toggle a complete stop on an error.  Allowed values: "TRUE", "FALSE".  Default value: "TRUE".

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: The optional parallelism parameter can be set to reduce the number of threads used by the bulk load process.

options.name: --parser-configuration
options.description: ParserConfiguration    –   An optional object with additional parser configuration values.
